div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Operator

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vector import from a design tool
Parsed server-side into a canonical manifest.
No design-tool credentials in the backend.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Manifest validator
Canvas and aspect, exactly one product slot,
digest-pinned assets, supported styles only

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
overlay_designs
Library row. Groups revisions.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
design_revisions
Draft to locked to archived, monotonic.
design_digest: render-equivalent designs
hash equal. Editing a locked revision
forks a new one.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
placement_rules
Desired state: this item set uses this
locked revision for this output slot.
No inline render or publish.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Runtime compiler
Locked revision plus pinned asset manifest
to deterministic artifact bytes.
Asset digest mismatch fails compilation.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Artifact store
Create-only writes, opaque paths.
Returns a stable ref and content hash.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
render_batches
One coarse row per bulk run.
Batched counters, no per-item rows.
Resumable and idempotent.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Item-set enumerator
Paginates the partner item set, maps external
item id to internal variant identity, returns
resolved, skipped and unresolved counts.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Composition resolver
Versioned hash over artifact ref and hash,
product image path and version, crop and focal
inputs, contract version. Product image is
referenced as path and version, not as a URL.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Object already present
at the derived key?

div.style: color: rgb(74, 35, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rasterizer
Pinned version. Containment: no network access,
no external entity resolution, hard caps on
memory, wall time and output dimensions.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Conditional create upload
If-absent precondition. An object that already
exists is treated as success, since two jobs
with the same digest produce identical bytes.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
image_outputs
Immutable output record: identity, digests,
storage key, public URL, checksum, lifecycle

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
feed_image_index
One current row per catalog item and slot.
Composition digest, object path, active state,
priority, overlay_tag.
Current state only, updated in place.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Index resolver
The only overlay read on the request path.
One bounded batched lookup,
behind a kill switch.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payload serializer
Merchant primary image is preserved.
Merchant additional images are preserved.
Generated images are appended under their own
externally selectable tag while capacity remains.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Partner feed API
Fetches finished static images directly from
object storage. No request-time renderer.

div.style: color: rgb(63, 52, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fail-open · feed serving layer only
Resolver error or kill switch: serialize the
merchant's own images and continue.
A degraded overlay subsystem must not
degrade a merchant's listing.

div.style: color: rgb(63, 52, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fail-closed · authoring and render layers
Unverified artifact, digest mismatch or failed
rasterization: no render, no publish.
Incorrect pixels published under a live tag
cannot be corrected by retry.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 32, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kill switch · request path
Disables the index lookup entirely.
No rows are modified, instantly reversible,
merchant images unaffected.
